title: 噪声与听力保护
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/150_噪声与听力保护.md

points.S1: 噪声是职业病危害因素

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着耳罩，指指耳朵
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears hearing protection earmuffs and points at its ears, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第13章第四课：噪声与听力保护。

shots.scene: 欣欣摘下耳罩，捂住耳朵皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot takes off the earmuffs and covers its ears with a frown as a loud noise icon appears.
shots.narration: 听力伤了，就很难再回来。

shots.scene: 阿杰在超声破碎仪旁做样品
shots.prompt_en: In a university laboratory, the young male student works next to a loud ultrasonic cell disruptor with sound wave icons around it.
shots.narration: 阿杰在超声破碎仪旁，一做一下午。

shots.scene: 旁边的真空泵也在轰鸣
shots.prompt_en: Beside him, a vacuum pump on the floor runs loudly with sound wave icons.
shots.narration: 旁边的真空泵，也一直在响。

shots.scene: 下班后阿杰耳朵嗡嗡响
shots.prompt_en: In the evening, the young male student touches his ear with a ringing icon near his head.
shots.narration: 下班后，他耳朵里嗡嗡直响。

shots.scene: 小研递给他一副耳罩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands him a pair of earmuffs and points at the noisy instrument.
shots.narration: 小研：噪声大，要护耳朵。

shots.scene: 耳朵内部毛细胞被声波打倒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tiny hair cells inside an ear being flattened by strong sound waves. No text.
shots.narration: 长期噪声，会慢慢损伤听力。

shots.scene: 听力受损后难以恢复
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damaged ear icon with a one way arrow and a broken link. No text.
shots.narration: 噪声性听力损失，往往不可逆。

shots.scene: 耳鸣图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a head with ringing waves inside the ear. No text.
shots.narration: 还会耳鸣、听不清别人说话。

shots.scene: 疲劳、烦躁、注意力下降
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a tired face, an irritated face and a scattered attention symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 噪声让人疲劳、烦躁、易出错。

shots.scene: 噪声加振动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vibrating machine with sound waves and shaking lines. No text.
shots.narration: 又吵又震，更容易疲劳。

shots.section_title: 噪声是职业病危害因素
shots.scene: 职业病防治法书本和耳朵图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed law book with an ear icon and a warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 噪声，是法定的职业病危害因素。
overlay: 噪声是职业病危害因素

shots.section_title: 噪声是职业病危害因素
shots.scene: 国家职业卫生标准规定接触限值
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed standard book next to a sound level meter with a blank display. No text.
shots.narration: 国家标准规定了噪声接触限值。

shots.section_title: 噪声是职业病危害因素
shots.scene: 声级计测量工作场所噪声
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer measures the noise near a compressor with a sound level meter, the display blank.
shots.narration: 噪声大的场所，要检测和告知。

shots.section_title: 噪声是职业病危害因素
shots.scene: 噪声作业人员体检
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker having a hearing test with headphones in a clinic booth. No text.
shots.narration: 长期接触，按规定做听力检查。

shots.section_title: 噪声是职业病危害因素
shots.scene: 噪声聋列入职业病目录
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ear icon inside a list on a closed official catalogue. No text.
shots.narration: 噪声聋，属于法定职业病。

shots.scene: 实验室噪声设备一排图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a vacuum pump, an air compressor, an ultrasonic cell disruptor, an ultrasonic bath and a centrifuge. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室里，也有不少吵闹的设备。

shots.scene: 超声破碎仪发出尖锐声波
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ultrasonic cell disruptor probe in a tube emitting sharp sound waves. No text.
shots.narration: 超声破碎仪，声音尖锐刺耳。

shots.scene: 真空泵、空压机持续轰鸣
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vacuum pump and an air compressor running with continuous sound waves and a clock. No text.
shots.narration: 真空泵、空压机，一响就是半天。

shots.scene: 工程训练中心的机床、砂轮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a machine workshop with a lathe and a grinder producing loud noise. No text.
shots.narration: 实训车间的机床、砂轮，噪声更大。

shots.scene: 近距离说话要喊才能听见
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two people one meter apart, one shouting to be heard over machine noise. No text.
shots.narration: 近处说话要喊，噪声就太大了。

shots.scene: 控制层级：源头、隔离、管理、防护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a four step pyramid with icons, a quiet machine, a barrier, a schedule and earmuffs at the bottom. No text.
shots.narration: 控制噪声，先从源头想办法。

shots.scene: 选低噪声设备，维护保养
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a quieter pump model chosen and a technician tightening loose parts and oiling. No text.
shots.narration: 选低噪声设备，坏了松了及时修。

shots.scene: 超声破碎仪放进隔音箱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ultrasonic cell disruptor placed inside a closed sound insulation box. No text.
shots.narration: 超声破碎仪，放进隔音箱用。

shots.scene: 真空泵加罩，放进隔开的设备间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vacuum pump under an acoustic cover and an air compressor moved into a separate room with the door closed. No text.
shots.narration: 泵和空压机，加罩或隔开放。

shots.scene: 噪声设备远离人多的工位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: noisy equipment placed away from desks and seating areas, distance arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 吵的设备，远离工位和人多处。

shots.scene: 缩短停留时间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock with a short time segment beside a noisy machine and a person stepping away. No text.
shots.narration: 用完就关，少在旁边停留。

shots.scene: 耳塞和耳罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pair of foam earplugs and a pair of earmuffs side by side. No text.
shots.narration: 做不到降噪，就戴护听器。

shots.scene: 噪声高低对应不同护听器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a noise level bar from low to high with earplugs and earmuffs matched, and both together at the top. No text.
shots.narration: 按噪声高低，选合适的耳塞耳罩。

shots.scene: 耳塞小巧、耳罩方便
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: earplugs fitting in a pocket and earmuffs being put on and off quickly. No text.
shots.narration: 耳塞小巧，耳罩戴摘方便。

shots.scene: 设备旁挂护听标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a must wear ear protection sign on the wall beside a noisy compressor. No text.
shots.narration: 看到护听标志，就要戴上。

shots.scene: 戴了护听器也少待
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person wearing earmuffs with a short clock beside a noisy machine. No text.
shots.narration: 戴了护听器，也要少待。

shots.scene: 棉花团塞耳，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cotton ball stuffed into an ear, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 棉花团、纸巾，挡不住噪声。

shots.scene: 【实拍】洗净的手把泡沫耳塞搓细（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: clean hands rolling a foam earplug into a thin tight cylinder.
shots.narration: 戴耳塞：先洗手，把耳塞搓细。

shots.scene: 【实拍】另一只手绕过头顶拉起耳廓，塞入耳塞（侧面特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up side view: one hand reaches over the head to pull the ear up and back while the other inserts the rolled earplug.
shots.narration: 手绕过头顶拉耳廓，把耳塞塞进去。

shots.scene: 【实拍】手指按住耳塞等它膨胀（侧面特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up side view: a fingertip holds the earplug in place while the foam expands to fill the ear canal.
shots.narration: 手指按住，等它膨胀贴合。

shots.scene: 只塞了一半的耳塞，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an earplug only half inserted and sticking out of the ear, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只塞一半，几乎没用。

shots.scene: 【实拍】戴耳罩，罩杯完全包住耳朵（侧面中景）
shots.prompt_en: Side view: a person putting on earmuffs, adjusting the headband so the cups fully seal around both ears, hair tucked away.
shots.narration: 戴耳罩：罩杯包住整个耳朵。

shots.scene: 头发、眼镜腿压在罩边，漏缝
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: thick hair and a glasses arm under an earmuff cushion leaving a gap, warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 头发、帽子别压在罩边。

shots.scene: 【实拍】双手捂耳对比声音，检查佩戴效果（中景）
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot: a person cups hands over the ears and releases, checking that the sound barely changes.
shots.narration: 捂耳试一下，声音没大变就戴好了。

shots.scene: 一次性耳塞丢弃，耳罩擦净存放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used disposable earplugs into a bin, and earmuff cushions wiped clean and stored in a bag. No text.
shots.narration: 一次性耳塞不重复用，耳罩擦净。

shots.scene: 戴着护听器，报警灯在闪
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person wearing earmuffs while a red flashing alarm light blinks on the ceiling. No text.
shots.narration: 戴着护听器，也要留意报警。

shots.scene: 高噪声区装闪光报警
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fire alarm sounder with a flashing strobe light in a noisy equipment room. No text.
shots.narration: 噪声大的地方，看报警闪灯。

shots.scene: 做实验戴耳机听歌，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student wearing music headphones at a lab bench, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 做实验别戴耳机听歌。

shots.scene: 有警示就听从，按要求防护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a warning sign at the entrance of a hot and noisy room, a person putting on earmuffs before entering. No text.
shots.narration: 有警示标志，就照要求防护。

shots.scene: 王老师叮嘱定时离开噪声区
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reminds the young male student to step out of the noisy room for a break.
shots.narration: 定时离开噪声区，让耳朵休息。

shots.scene: 噪声伤听力，不可逆
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ear with sound waves and a one way arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 噪声伤听力，往往不可逆。

shots.scene: 源头、隔开、少待
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a quiet machine, a closed sound box and a short clock. No text.
shots.narration: 先控源头，加罩隔开，少待。

shots.scene: 耳塞耳罩戴对，留意报警
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an earplug, an earmuff and a flashing alarm light. No text.
shots.narration: 护听器戴对，同时留意报警。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着防尘口罩挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a particulate respirator mask and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：粉尘、烟尘与纳米材料。
